<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אדר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917498_theRebbe_163" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_93_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917498_theRebbe_163__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening header and date for the maamar for Purim 5744.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B'Siyata D'Shmaya.</t>
    <t s="1">Purim 5744*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the essence of the miracle was the king's sleep being disturbed, as interpreted by the Rebbe and the Maharil.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"On that night, the king's sleep was disturbed,"</t>
    <t s="1">and the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Rebbe, brings in his maamar beginning with the word "Zeh,"</t>
    <t s="2">that it is stated in the Minhagei Maharil</t>
    <t s="3">that from "on that night" one must raise his voice in its reading, because this is the essence of the miracle</t>
    <t s="4">[for "on that night" is the beginning of the intensity of the miracle].</t>
    <t s="5">And he makes a precise point about this,</t>
    <t s="6">that at first glance the essence of the miracle was Esther's request and her supplications, "for we have been sold, I and my people,"</t>
    <t s="7">[and also the preparations she made beforehand,</t>
    <t s="8">"Go, gather all the Jews... and fast for me"],</t>
    <t s="9">yet here it says that the essence and intensity of the miracle is that the king's sleep was disturbed.</t>
    <t s="10">And he brings on this,</t>
    <t s="11">that it is stated in the Yalkut,</t>
    <t s="12">"On that night, the king's sleep was disturbed" — this is the King of the World,</t>
    <t s="13">and is there sleep before Him?</t>
    <t s="14">Rather, when Israel sins, He makes Himself as if asleep,</t>
    <t s="15">and when they do His will, [He does] not,</t>
    <t s="16">"He neither slumbers nor sleeps."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the disturbance of the King's sleep is the essence of the miracle, because exile is a time of sleep, and the miracle was that this sleep was shaken off.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="1">that behold, man is a "likeness of the Supernal,"</t>
    <t s="2">and therefore all the matters above are in the same manner as they are in man</t>
    <t s="3">("You are called 'man'"),</t>
    <t s="4">"above, corresponding to the pattern below,"</t>
    <t s="5">and in the language of the verse,</t>
    <t s="6">"As water reflects a face back to a face, so the heart of man to man,"</t>
    <t s="7">and therefore,</t>
    <t s="8">when Israel are in a state of sleep,</t>
    <t s="9">meaning that the matters of Torah and Mitzvos</t>
    <t s="10">(through which they are a "likeness of the Supernal")</t>
    <t s="11">are in a state of sleep for them,</t>
    <t s="12">through this, sleep is caused, as it were, also in the King of the World.</t>
    <t s="13">And as it is written,</t>
    <t s="14">"I am asleep," and it is stated in the Zohar</t>
    <t s="15">"in exile,"</t>
    <t s="16">that from the side of the sleep of Israel during the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="17">through this, sleep is caused, as it were, also above.</t>
    <t s="18">And this is that "on that night the king's sleep was disturbed" is the intensity of the miracle,</t>
    <t s="19">because according to the order of the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="20">the time of exile is a time of sleep</t>
    <t s="21">(above),</t>
    <t s="22">and that "on that night"</t>
    <t s="23">(exile)</t>
    <t s="24">"the king's sleep was disturbed" — the King of the World — this is the intensity of the miracle.</t>
    <t s="25">And this is also the precise meaning of the expression "the king's sleep was disturbed"</t>
    <t s="26">(specifically "was disturbed"),</t>
    <t s="27">for the expression "the king's sleep was disturbed"</t>
    <t s="28">(that sleep was disturbed from the king)</t>
    <t s="29">indicates that it was fitting for sleep to be upon the king</t>
    <t s="30">[similar to what is said about a person who was disturbed from his place],</t>
    <t s="31">because the time of exile is a time of sleep</t>
    <t s="32">(as above),</t>
    <t s="33">except that there was a miracle that the sleep was disturbed from Him.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
